name: Generalization Benchmark v7 (Held-Out)
description: 200 unseen reasoning and generalization tasks across 15 categories, split into 160 dev and 40 test cases.

cases.input: Every device with firmware 2.0 has Bluetooth enabled. Device X has firmware 2.0. All Bluetooth devices can pair with headphones. Can Device X pair with headphones? Answer Yes or No.
Alice is taller than Bob. Bob is taller than Charlie. Charlie is taller than David. Who is the second tallest person?
If packet loss exceeds 5%, the router triggers a failover. If failover is triggered, an SMS alert is sent to on-call. Currently packet loss is 7%. Will on-call receive an SMS alert? Answer Yes or No.
Box A contains a red key. The red key opens Door 1. Behind Door 1 is a blue key. The blue key opens the treasure chest. Where must you look first to ultimately open the treasure chest?
Only registered users can submit comments. Guest_42 is not registered. Can Guest_42 submit a comment? Answer Yes or No.
Server A sends logs to Server B every 10 seconds. Server B archives logs to S3 every 60 seconds. What is the maximum delay before a log generated on Server A reaches S3? Answer in seconds.
If it rains, the grass is wet. If the grass is wet, the lawnmower slips. It is currently raining. Will the lawnmower slip? Answer Yes or No.
All primary databases require WAL archiving. PostgreSQL replica 3 is a secondary, not a primary. Does PostgreSQL replica 3 necessarily require WAL archiving based only on this rule? Answer Yes or No.
Container Alpha depends on Container Beta. Container Beta depends on Database Gamma. In what order must Database Gamma, Container Alpha, and Container Beta be started? List them from first to last.
A train leaves City 1 at 1:00 PM and takes 2 hours to reach City 2. It stops at City 2 for 30 minutes, then takes 1 hour to reach City 3. At what time does it arrive at City 3?

Token expires in 3600 seconds. 45 minutes have passed since token generation. Is the token still valid? Answer Yes or No.
Three switches (1, 2, 3) control three lights (A, B, C). Switch 1 controls B. Switch 2 does not control A. Which light does switch 2 control?

All mammals breathe air. Dolphins are mammals. Do dolphins breathe air? Answer Yes or No.
No triangle has four sides. Shape Z is a triangle. How many sides does Shape Z have?
All integers ending in 0 are divisible by 10. The number 340 ends in 0. Is 340 divisible by 10? Answer Yes or No.
Any file ending in .py is a Python source file. File 'analyzer.py' ends in .py. What kind of file is 'analyzer.py'?
If a process receives SIGKILL, it terminates immediately. Process 8821 received SIGKILL. Did Process 8821 terminate immediately? Answer Yes or No.
All prime numbers greater than 2 are odd. 17 is a prime number greater than 2. Is 17 odd or even?
No unauthenticated request can read user profiles. Request #109 is unauthenticated. Can Request #109 read user profiles? Answer Yes or No.

All valid IPv4 octets are integers between 0 and 255. The octet under test is 289. Is this a valid IPv4 octet? Answer Yes or No.
All SSDs lack moving mechanical parts. Drive D is an SSD. Does Drive D have moving mechanical parts? Answer Yes or No.
All equilateral triangles have three equal angles of 60 degrees. Triangle ABC is equilateral. What is the measure of angle A in degrees?
Any function marked 'async' returns a coroutine or awaitable in Python. Function 'fetch_data' is marked async. Does calling 'fetch_data()' return a coroutine? Answer Yes or No.
No read-only file system allows file creation. System /mnt/archive is mounted read-only. Can a user create a new file in /mnt/archive? Answer Yes or No.
All square numbers have an odd number of positive divisors. 36 is a square number (6^2). Does 36 have an odd or even number of positive divisors?
The daily backup ran successfully on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday. What is the expected outcome of the backup on Saturday under identical conditions?
Observations: Raven 1 is black, Raven 2 is black, Raven 3 is black, Raven 4 is black. What color do you inductively predict Raven 5 will be?

A website deployment was performed on 10 consecutive Fridays, and all 10 caused weekend outages. Inductively, what is likely to happen if another deployment occurs this Friday without process changes?
